Spending is listed by object only; each object line takes the function of the fund holding most of it (Fire Department Expenses = public safety), marked review; capital outlay statement lines labelled 'Capital Outlay' (mixed funds / no function printed). Beginning cash not printed separately (beginning_cash null); fund-balance roll-forward ties: 390,980.80 + 260,110.24 - 237,991.35 + 8,358.78 - 8,358.78 = 413,099.69. Ending cash = Total Assets (Cash and Deposits + County Treasurers' Balance) p11. Water 'Machinery & Equipment' 26,158.33 (p12) is printed as 'Capital Outlay' on the budget schedule p16. 'Grants' 18,849.20 on the combining schedule is printed 'State Grant' on the statement. Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds statement p11 (totals equal the government-wide figures p1), business-type from the Statement of Net Position p1. Detail: General Fund combining receipts p13 and disbursements p14 (General / Fire Department / Ball Park / Bank Building columns; only fund-level 'Original & Final Budgeted Disbursements' printed: General 135,257.93, Fire 309,215.09, Ball Park 42,251.64, Bank Building 7,385.86, so budget_final null); Street Fund budget schedule p15 (lines with no actual - Miscellaneous receipts budget 1,000 and capital outlay Equipment budget 19,103.71 - not recorded); proprietary budget schedule p16 per fund, its single combined budget column (e.g. operating disbursements 99,864.17, capital outlay 9,985.33, transfers in 10,000) not assignable to a fund, so budget_final null. p17 combined statement of changes in fund balances (unaudited) ties to the above.
